title: Spanish fashion giant Mango: From small clothing shop to its founder's tragic death
subhead: In May, Jonathan Andic was arrested on suspicion of murdering his 71-year-old father, who fell to his death in a ravine in 2024. It was a shocking and tragic end for Isak Andic, a son of Turkish immigrants who turned a small second-hand clothing shop in Barcelona into a thriving textile empire over the course of nearly four decades.

title: Moscow casts a shadow over crucial Swiss vote on neutrality
subhead: On September 27, Swiss citizens are set to vote on a popular initiative from the nationalist right aimed at enshrining a stricter form of neutrality, which would, for example, prevent Bern from sanctioning a belligerent country like Russia.

title: 'In Port-au-Prince, Haiti, when violence decreases in one neighborhood, it increases elsewhere'
subhead: Another massacre took place on the outskirts of the Haitian capital over the night of August 23-24. Researcher Frédéric Thomas, in this op-ed for Le Monde, examines the rise of armed gangs while questioning the strategies of both Haitian authorities and the international community.
